theme_and_archetype.description: A high-end, sovereign-grade financial dashboard combining deep cinematic luxury with organic sustainability. Uses the 'Crystal' glassmorphism variant to signal transparency and trust in blockchain/carbon credit settlements.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: The Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6. Dense data visualization.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding for glass cards. Minimum p-6 or p-8 to prevent text from colliding with borders.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict mobile-first layout. Text left-aligned for metrics, numbers right-aligned in tables.
spacing_and_layout.constraints: Images and decorative elements must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

glassmorphism.usage: Use for main dashboard widgets, sticky headers, and auth modals.

glassmorphism_active.usage: Use for the selected asset, active trade tab, or focused input form.

component_guidelines.cards: Never use solid flat color. Always use glassmorphism class string. No heavy border radius (max rounded-xl).
component_guidelines.buttons: Primary CTAs (Buy/Sell/Execute) use solid emerald_primary with dark inverse text and subtle glow. Secondary buttons use transparent background with border-white/20 and hover:bg-white/10.
component_guidelines.inputs_and_forms: Use Shadcn components. Override background to bg-white/5, border-white/10. Focus states must use ring-emerald-500/50.
component_guidelines.tables: Crucial for order book and settlement engine. Zebra striping should be very subtle (bg-white/[0.02]). Header rows must have a bottom border border-white/10.
component_guidelines.charts: Use Recharts. Ensure chart grid lines are very faint (stroke='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'). Use the brand_accents colors for lines and bars.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow. Buttons transition background and text color explicitly.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer Motion staggered children. Fade in and slide up from y: 10 with duration 0.4s ease-out.
motion_and_interactions.microinteractions: Data updates in trading dashboard should flash very subtly (green for up, red for down).

icons.style: Clean, thin stroke width (1.5px), usually text-secondary color unless active.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. If using translucent backgrounds, add a very subtle dark overlay beneath text if it clashes with background.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and key metrics MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure Tailwind CSS. Apply 'glassmorphism' classes to the Shadcn components.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is loaded for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use #060B12 for the absolute darkest background.
Rely heavily on 'backdrop-blur-2xl' for the depth effect instead of opaque layers.
Implement region-based compliance logic inside the dashboard, utilizing the green-status accents for 'verified' and 'compliant' states.
Use Framer Motion to stagger the entry of dashboard bento widgets.
Always apply data-testid to every interactive component.
